test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form.

"Was your phone being charged by someone?"
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice sentence: "Was your phone being charged by someone?"
 
• To convert to active voice: Identify the subject of the passive sentence ("someone"), and make it the subject of the active voice sentence.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was being charged" to "was charging" to reflect the active voice form.
 
• The object "your phone" remains the same in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Was someone charging your phone?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Has someone charged your phone?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"Did someone charge your phone?" – Incorrect tense (past simple).
 
• **Option 4: **"Is someone charging your phone?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous).
